papers.title: Sliding wear behavior of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V: The effect of thermal treatment

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究热处理对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V滑动磨损行为的影响，而非本方向重点关注的力学与疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: Focuses on sliding wear and thermal treatment effects, not on tensile, fatigue, or other core mechanical properties of as-built Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究热处理对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V滑动磨损性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对LPBF制备的Ti-6Al-4V样品进行不同类型热处理，并进行滑动磨损测试。
summary_zh.result: 热处理显著改变显微组织，提高耐磨性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过磨损测试和微观表征验证效果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of thermal treatments on the sliding wear behavior of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Ti-6Al-4V samples fabricated by LPBF were subjected to various thermal treatments and then tested under sliding wear conditions.
summary_en.result: Thermal treatments significantly altered the microstructure, leading to improved wear resistance.
summary_en.validation: Wear testing and microstructural characterization validated the findings.

papers.title: Effect of Heat Treatment on Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of (TiB + TiC) /Ti-6Al-4V Composites Fabricated by Directed Energy Deposition
papers.abstract: The titanium matrix composites (TMCs) fabricated via Directed Energy Deposition (DED) effectively overcome the issue of coarse columnar grains typically observed in additively manufactured titanium alloys. In this study, systematic annealing heat treatments were applied to in situ (TiB + TiC)/Ti-6Al-4V composites to refine the microstructure and tailor mechanical properties. The results reveal that the plate-like α phase in the as-deposited composites gradually transforms into an equiaxed morphology with increasing annealing temperature and holding time. Notably, when the annealing temperature exceeds 1000 °C, significant coarsening of the TiC phase is observed, while the TiB phase remains morphologically stable. Annealing promotes decomposition of acicular martensite and stress relaxation, leading to a reduction in hardness compared to the as-deposited state. However, the reticulated distribution of the TiB and TiC reinforcement phases contributes to enhanced tensile performance. Specifically, the as-deposited composite achieves a tensile strength of 1109 MPa in the XOY direction, representing a 21.6% improvement over the as-cast counterpart, while maintaining a ductility of 2.47%. These findings demonstrate that post-deposition annealing is an effective strategy to regulate microstructure and achieve a desirable balance between strength and ductility in DED-fabricated titanium matrix composites.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了退火热处理对DED制备的(TiB+TiC)/Ti-6Al-4V复合材料显微组织和拉伸性能的影响，但并非纯Ti-6Al-4V，且未涉及疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies Ti-6Al-4V matrix composites reinforced with TiB and TiC, not pure Ti-6Al-4V, and does not report fatigue testing, which is a key metric for post-processing control of mechanical performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 改善DED钛基复合材料粗大柱状晶与性能。
summary_zh.method: 对(TiB+TiC)/Ti-6Al-4V进行不同温度与时间的退火处理。
summary_zh.result: 退火使α相从片状转为等轴，硬度下降但拉伸强度提升至1109 MPa。
summary_zh.validation: 通过扫描电镜与拉伸试验验证显微组织与力学性能变化。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome coarse columnar grains in additively manufactured titanium alloys by applying post-deposition annealing to titanium matrix composites.
summary_en.method: Systematic annealing treatments at various temperatures and holding times were applied to in situ (TiB + TiC)/Ti-6Al-4V composites fabricated by DED.
summary_en.result: Annealing transformed plate-like α phase into equiaxed morphology, reduced hardness, but enhanced tensile strength to 1109 MPa in the XOY direction.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural evolution and tensile properties were validated through SEM characterization and mechanical testing.

papers.title: Chip Flow Direction Modeling and Chip Morphology Analysis of Ball-End Milling Cutters
papers.abstract: Ball-end milling cutters are normally used for complex surface machining. During the milling process, the tool posture and cutting parameters of the ball-end milling cutters have a significant impact on chip formations and morphological changes. Based on the Cutter Workpiece Engagement (CWE) model, this study establishes a chip flow model for ball-end milling cutters with consideration of the tool posture variation. The machining experiments of Ti-6Al-4V with a 15° inclined plane and different feed directions were carried out. The influence mechanism of time-varying tool posture on chip formation was systematically investigated. The results reveal an interaction between the chip flow direction and the cutting velocity direction. The included angle between the chip flow directions at the maximum and minimum contact points in the CWE area affects the degree of chip curling, with a smaller angle leading to weaker curling. This research provides a theoretical foundation for the optimization of posture parameters of ball-end milling cutters and expounds on the influence of the chip flow angle on chip deformation.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是Ti-6Al-4V铣削过程中的切屑流动，而非任何后处理工艺（如热处理、HIP、喷丸等），因此与L2方向完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on chip morphology and flow modeling during ball-end milling, which is a subtractive machining process, not a post-processing treatment such as heat treatment, HIP, shot peening, or surface coating. No post-processing effect on mechanical/fatigue performance is studied.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究球头铣刀在不同刀具姿态下切屑流动与形态变化。
summary_zh.method: 基于CWE模型建立考虑刀具姿态变化的切屑流动模型，并进行Ti-6Al-4V铣削实验。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了切屑流动方向与切削速度方向之间的相互作用，以及切屑卷曲程度的影响因素。
summary_zh.validation: 通过Ti-6Al-4V斜面铣削实验验证模型。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to understand chip formation and morphological changes in ball-end milling under varying tool posture.
summary_en.method: A chip flow model incorporating tool posture variation was developed based on the Cutter Workpiece Engagement model, and milling experiments on Ti-6Al-4V with an inclined plane were conducted.
summary_en.result: Interaction between chip flow direction and cutting velocity direction was found, with the included angle in CWE area influencing chip curling degree.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was performed via machining Ti-6Al-4V samples with different feed directions.
